New York: Cartier's owner just posted its fastest-growing region, and it's ours.

Richemont said group sales in the Americas rose 23% in the six months to 30 September, the fastest of any region it gave a figure for. Jewellery Maisons grew sales 19% worldwide at constant rates. Operating profit rose 33% to €3.1 billion, including €229 million of tariff-related one-time items.
